question_record.context: A security incident involving malicious credential theft tool execution was detected on 2024-07-04. The credential theft tool 'mimikatz.exe' with a command line indicating an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, and plain-text passwords was executed from both Process IDs 3932 and 1044. This was observed at the IP address `107.224.99.179`. Following this, a potential lateral movement event was identified involving PSExec to the server named Vnevado-jump on 2024-07-10. Further investigation revealed a suspicious remote activity detected on 2024-07-04, which flagged potentially malicious activities originating from a remote machine.
question_record.question: What is the AadUserId of the account associated with the suspicious remote activity on 2024-07-04?
solution: There was a detected execution of a known credential theft tool on the host with AadDeviceId `4d8d23e9-a77d-4e33-9435-b8c457e57ca1`.
Lateral movement using PSExec to the jump server with IP address `99.83.111.100` was observed.
Suspicious remote activity was initiated by the user with AadUserId `731adb71-b11c-4bbf-850b-57989b350e96`.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
